sloka: यद्यधर्मो न बलवान् स्यादयं राक्षसेश्वरः ।स्यादय सुरलोकस्य सशक्रस्यापि रक्षिता ।। ५.४९.१८।।।।
transliteration: yadyadharmo na balavān syādayaṁ rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।syādaya suralokasya saśakrasyāpi rakṣitā ।। 5.49.18।।।।

translations.english: 'If only this lord of demons was not unrighteous, he could have become even the lord (protector) of gods including Indra.
